test_item_verbatim: When the Surround View Camera soft button is pressed and the vehicle speed is less than 8mph, ($Speedometer$ < [8 MPH]), the HU shall display the video image, as specified by HMI, and send the SVC_DisplaySts = [SVC image displayed] signal to the CVPM, within <Tsend> of keypress.

tcs.tc_title: SVC image below the speed threshold, press the virtual button below 8 mph and check that the video image is displayed
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Surround_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. CAN source: BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig (HDCC27, DT27) / STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig (637, 2261, 376)
4. PENDING: DR-CAM-j the SVC_DisplaySts signal is not present in the four DBC files in forms
5. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 205 (12.8125 km/h)
2. Press the virtual Surround View Camera button on the HU display
3. Read the HU display and the bus analyzer recording and check the video image and the SVC_DisplaySts signal
tcs.expected_result:
1. BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 205 (12.8125 km/h) is sent
2. The virtual Surround View Camera button registers the press
3. The Surround View Camera video image is displayed on the HU display and PENDING: DR-CAM-j the SVC_DisplaySts = SVC image displayed signal is sent to the CVPM within Tsend of the keypress
tcs.split_reason: SVC image below the speed threshold
tcs.test_item:
When the Surround View Camera soft button is pressed and the vehicle speed is less than 8mph, ($Speedometer$ < [8 MPH]), the HU shall display the video image, as specified by HMI, and send the SVC_DisplaySts = [SVC image displayed] signal to the CVPM, within <Tsend> of keypress.

(SVC image below the speed threshold, press the virtual button below 8 mph and check that the video image is displayed)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 CFTS092 `SYS-RA-CAM-090`（ObjectID 4781655，Surround View Camera 節）之「按下 SVC 鍵且車速低於 8 mph 時顯示影像並送 `SVC_DisplaySts`」。上半為摘句（§4.3.1）：原句 56 token 逾 50，刪去括號內之 `(HU receives the internal signal SVC IMAGE ON)` 八個 token，摘後 48 token；為原句 token 之保序子序列，條件（`$Speedometer$ < [8 MPH]`）與結果（顯示影像、送 `SVC_DisplaySts`）兩子句皆保留。速度供試值取 raw 205 = 12.8125 km/h = 7.9614 mph（< 8 mph）—— 四本 DBC 之 `VehicleSpeedVSOSig` 因子皆為 (0.0625,0) "Km/h"。**`SVC_DisplaySts` 於四本 DBC 零命中**，其 message 與 raw 值標 `PENDING: DR-CAM-j`；影像顯示側仍可判，故本列不整列 BLOCKED。門檻之達標側由 `NR1L-RVC-041` 承接（軟鍵灰階）。本列依 **R-CAM13(c)** 落 Test Set `Auxiliary Cameras`（framework Part VIII 第 10 組，CAM-06 重開）；其 SWE 列 `SWE-CAM-016` 於 Layer 2 仍歸 `Display Arbitration`，「組 ↔ SWE 列」與「TC ↔ Test Set」於本組分離。A-CA28 之「不生成」處置作廢。
